# patch

Apply unified or context patches through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/patch --dry-run -p1 -i changes.patch

moonx cli/patch -p1 -i changes.patch --output=- > patched.txt
```

Read a patch from stdin or -i, resolve target paths and apply matching hunks. Offset matching and fuzz are supported; default fuzz is two.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-p VALUE`, `--strip VALUE` | remove N leading file-name components |
| `-i VALUE`, `--input VALUE` | read the patch from FILE instead of stdin |
| `-o VALUE`, `--output VALUE` | write patched files to stdout |
| `-r VALUE`, `--reject-file VALUE` | write rejected hunks to a new FILE; - discards |
| `-R`, `--reverse` | apply additions as removals and vice versa |
| `--dry-run` | check without writing or deleting files |
| `-F VALUE`, `--fuzz VALUE` | Ignore up to this many outer context lines. Default: `2`. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

Workspace builds use the MoonBit 2026-11-26 toolchain.

- Rewriting existing files and named --output paths are rejected because source mode metadata is unavailable. Use --dry-run or --output=-; creating a new patch target remains supported.
- Existing reject files cannot be replaced. Binary patches and extended rename/mode patch formats are unsupported.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
